values.note: Indian River County: electric sites 27-30 $35/night; primitive sites 1-26 $25/night. Read 2026-10-21.
26 primitive campsites (1 group/double site) and 5 sites with electricity; 'RV's over 30 ft. are best suited for the Indian River County Fairgrounds Campground.' Two vehicles and two tents per site.

sites.source: https://indianriver.gov/business_detail_T21_R9.php ('Features include 26 primitive campsites (1 group/double site) and 5 sites with electricity'; 'RV's over 30 ft. are best suited for the Indian River County Fairgrounds Campground'), read 2026-10-21

season.source: https://indianriver.gov/business_detail_T21_R9.php ('The campground & park are open 365 days per year'), read 2026-10-21

values.note: Reserve through the county's Rec1 catalog ('Reserve a campsite' on the park page). Two-week maximum per visit with a one-week break between visits, and no more than 6 weeks a year. Check-in after 2 pm, check-out by noon.

booking.source: https://indianriver.gov/business_detail_T21_R9.php ('RESERVE A CAMPSITE' link to secure.rec1.com; 'There is a two-week maximum limit on visits with a one week break between visits. Guest visits may not exceed 6 total weeks per year'; 'Check-in after 2pm; Check-out by noon'), read 2026-10-21

note: Indian River County park on the St. Sebastian River, 37 acres. Mostly primitive tent sites; only the 5 electric sites suit RVs, and the county steers RVs over 30 ft to its Fairgrounds Campground. Drive-in; boat launch, observation boardwalk. --Claude
summary: Confirmed $35 electric-site rate (primitive $25), 31 sites (26 primitive + 5 electric), hot showers, 14-night max, reservable; added Rec1 booking url, year-round season, drinking water, the 6-weeks-a-year visit limit. Note trimmed of site count, showers, reservation/max-stay and RV Life rating text. Not stated: electric amperage, water at the sites (left as derived), dump station, booking window. The Rec1 catalog is a JS app and was not read.
